Key points
• Chronodisruption: a serious disturbance of the internal temporal order of the biochemical, physiological and behavioral
circadian rhythms
• Epigenetics: science that studies the heritable regulation of gene expression without change in nucleotide sequence.
• Nutrigenetics: science that aims to study the effect of genetic variations on the interaction between diet and disease.
